ara::core::Optional<std::uint64_t> unique_id;
▽ △
Description:
std::uint16_t optional member variable which represents the unique id part of the IEEE1722
defined stream id header field.
This is used for a unambiguous identification of the IEEE1722 stream. Please note, the stream
id consist of the following fragment: 48bit MAC address and 16bit unique id.
The value range for mac_address shall be:
0x00 00 ... 0xFF FF: valid
For transmission, the middleware shall set the unique address part which is configured, if it is not
provided by the application.
Visibility:
protected
